visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed photographic slides that rotate; each slide has a background image with an overlaid content box containing a heading, paragraph, and a single CTA button. Prev/next navigation arrows and dot slide indicators.
contentPattern: One row per slide. Each row has two cells: an image cell (background photo) and a content cell (heading + paragraph + CTA link).
usage: Top-of-page hero carousel showcasing featured adventures/articles, each slide linking to a destination.
